status.main_product: LUNA soft ice cream machines and soft ice cream mixes
status.scope_reason: The company manufactures and sells commercial soft-serve ice cream machines under its own brand name LUNA.
status.evidence: According to the company's official website, LUMEN GmbH was founded in 1962 as a subsidiary of the IREKS Group and manufactures LUNA soft ice cream machines at its headquarters in Kulmbach, Germany.

claims.claim: The company reports that its soft ice cream machines utilize a hermetic overpressure system where filtered ambient air is fed to the freezing cylinder via an air compressor and a non-return valve to achieve an overrun of approximately 80%.
claims.source: LUMEN GmbH Official Website (Engineering in soft ice cream - Overrun)

claims.claim: The company reports that the LUNA L22 equipment line delivers a commercial freezing capacity rated at 35 kg per hour, or 350 portions of 100 g per hour, at an ambient temperature of 20°C.
claims.corrected: The company reports that the LUNA L22 equipment line delivers a commercial freezing capacity rated at 40 kg per hour, or 400 portions of 100 g per hour, at an ambient temperature of 20°C.
claims.source: LUMEN GmbH LUNA L22 Official Technical Datasheet

claims.claim: The company reports that the technical configuration of its LUNA L22 HL variant maintains a stable overrun between 70% and 100% depending on the mix composition, according to its official product datasheets.
claims.source: LUMEN GmbH LUNA L22 Official Technical Datasheet

claims.claim: The company reports the LUNA L22 model soft ice cream and milkshake machine configuration available in air-cooled and water-cooled variants.
claims.source: LUMEN GmbH LUNA L22 with LUNA-Box Datasheet

claims.claim: A third-party resale listing confirms the LUNA L99HL-FD model, a single-flavor, free-standing commercial soft-serve machine.
claims.source: Secondhand Catering Equipment Listing (Luna L99HL Ice Cream Machine)

claims.claim: Publicly documented commercial models include the LUNA L12 HL-2F self-service automated soft-serve ice cream vending machine configuration.

The company's standard commercial dispenser catalog comprises four distinct machine categories: the LUNA soft ice cream machine, the LUNA milkshake machine, the LunaMil slush ice machine, and an automated iced coffee machine.

The company reports that its LUNA soft-serve ice cream machines feature an hourly output capacity of 35 kg/h at an ambient temperature of 20° C, which equates to 350 portions of 100 g per hour, according to the official LUMEN product specifications.

The company reports that its compact LUNA Milkshake Machine holds a 15-litre product capacity and efficiently dispenses up to 120 cups of 300 ml shakes per hour to handle peak demand, according to distributor specifications.
claims.note: 15-litre product capacity and 120 cups of 300 ml shakes per hour

claims.claim: The company reports that its LUNA L22 ice cream machine configuration yields an output of 40 kg per hour at a 20°C ambient temperature, translating to approximately 400 portions of 100 grams each per hour.
claims.corrected: The company reports that its LUNA L22 ice cream machine configuration yields an output of 35 kg per hour at a 20°C ambient temperature, translating to approximately 350 portions of 100 grams each per hour.

claims.claim: The company reports a specific power consumption figure of 45 kWh per week for its LUNA soft ice cream machines, according to the official LUMEN GmbH Corporate Website.
claims.source: LUMEN GmbH Corporate Website (Our team Page)

claims.claim: The company reports the utilization of the recyclable refrigerant R 448 a, which maintains a Global Warming Potential (GWP) of less than 1,500, as stated on the LUMEN GmbH Corporate Website.
claims.note: The detail that refrigerant R 448 a maintains a Global Warming Potential (GWP) of less than 1,500 is unconfirmed on the official LUMEN GmbH website.

claims.claim: The company reports that its machines utilize the recyclable refrigerant R448A, which has a Global Warming Potential (GWP) below 1,500.
claims.note: The detail that refrigerant R448A has a Global Warming Potential (GWP) below 1,500 is unconfirmed on the official LUMEN GmbH website.

claims.claim: The company reports that the LUNA L22 soft ice cream maker model has a nominal power of 3.5 kW for the air-cooled version and 3.3 kW for the water-cooled version.
claims.source: LUMEN GmbH LUNA L22 Technical Datasheet

claims.claim: The company reports that its LUNA L22 commercial soft-serve machine features a touchscreen interface with operator guidance.
claims.source: LUMEN GmbH LUNA L22 Technical Datasheet

claims.claim: The company reports that its soft-serve and milkshake machines utilize integrated "Digitalisation 4.0" remote control technology that permanently analyzes operating status and transmits data via mobile phone text messaging via a programmable logic control (PLC) system.
The company historically introduced its first soft-serve ice cream machine featuring integrated touchscreen controls and Fernwirktechnik (telecontrol/telemetry)
claims.note: historically introduced its first soft-serve ice cream machine featuring integrated touchscreen controls and Fernwirktechnik

claims.claim: The company deploys an internal technical field service network that performs personal machine installation, on-site diagnostics, scheduled maintenance, and hardware repairs directly at client venues.
claims.note: internal technical field service network performing scheduled maintenance and hardware repairs on-site

claims.claim: The company provides technical support infrastructure utilizing "Digitalisation 4.0" remote control technology to perform permanent operating status analysis and online fault remediation before hardware failures impact customers.
The company reports that it manufactures its ice cream machines itself at its headquarters facility in Kulmbach, Germany (Source: IREKS Magazine Edition 2025).
LUMEN GmbH was founded in 1962 as a subsidiary of the internationally operating, owner-managed IREKS Group, which is owned by the Ruckdeschel family, as reported by the company.
claims.source: LUMEN GmbH Company Website (About Us & Press Releases) and IREKS Group Profile

claims.claim: LUMEN GmbH holds a registered share capital of €1,000,000, according to historical regulatory tracking from the District Court of Bayreuth.
claims.source: District Court of Bayreuth Commercial Register (HRB 160) tracking data via Fusionbase

claims.claim: LUMEN GmbH offers tailor-made leasing and financing solutions for ice cream machine purchases through a cooperation with partner MMV Leasing GmbH — LUMEN GmbH Website
claims.source: LUMEN GmbH Official Website (Cooperation for tailor-made financing announcement)

claims.claim: The company reports having customers in 90 countries worldwide.
claims.corrected: The parent company, IREKS Group, reports having customers in about 90 countries worldwide.
claims.note: The 90 countries claim belongs to the parent company, IREKS Group, not LUMEN GmbH itself.

claims.claim: The company reports that its customer AS Softeis GmbH (Arnold Soßna) started a soft ice cream project utilizing its machinery at the Westfield Centro in Oberhausen at the end of March 2022.
